item.description:
### Leaving an organisation now takes effect straight away
When an administrator removes this Mac from their organisation, the Mac finds out at its next check-in rather than up to a day later. Until now it kept enforcing the organisation's settings for the rest of the day, even though it had already been removed.
### Nothing is left behind when it does
Removal now clears everything the organisation put here: its blocked apps and sites, its guards, its filtering level, its name, and the account it signed you in with. The Mac returns to the opening setup screen as a personal Mac, with the lists and schedules you made yourself untouched. Safe Internet stays installed — you set that up yourself, and it keeps protecting you either way.
### A suspended organisation no longer leaves the Mac stuck
If an organisation was suspended rather than removed, the Mac could keep trying to reach it every minute, indefinitely, while still enforcing settings nobody could change any more. It now signs out the same way a removed device does.
